relationships.subject: Endothelial cells
relationships.evidence_quote: These data from in situ hybridization and ELISA indicate that VP mice exhibit a higher level of ET‐1 in the systemic circulation and local blood circulation, which is mainly produced and released by ECs.

relationships.subject: Endothelin-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The above results suggest that DRG neurons from mice with PVP are more sensitive to ET‐1 than those from sham control mice.

relationships.subject: BQ-123
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic (intraperitoneal) or local (intrathecal; targeting cells in the spinal cord and DRGs) administration of BQ‐123, a specific blocker of ETAR, almost completely reversed the established mechanical hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: Vascular pain
relationships.evidence_quote: ETAR expression was significantly increased on the ipsilateral L4‐5 DRG neurons of mice with PVP at 1, 2, 4, 8, and 13 weeks, compared with that of sham control mice

relationships.subject: Endothelin A receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: CKO mice displayed partial impairment of mechanical hyperalgesia (indicated by paw withdrawal threshold) and allodynia (indicated by frequency) development after vessel ligation compared with ETARf/f mice

key_findings: Endothelial ET-1 acts on neuronal ETAR in DRG nociceptors to drive vascular pain with mechanical hyperalgesia but no gliosis
Oral bosentan alleviates tourniquet-induced vascular pain in patients
